title: Semio OS Plugin Component Receipt
description: The generated, never committed binding of one plugin or extension component's semantic descriptor to the exact bytes one build profile produced. The describe stage writes it beside the shipped bytes; descriptor verification, module materialization and the trusted catalog read it.

ComponentProfile.description: `release` is the one shipped profile; `prototype` is the local-only single-plugin loop whose bytes are never shipped.

ComponentProfilePolicyV1.description: The fixed directory, byte cap and shipping admission of every component profile, keyed by profile.

ComponentProfilePolicies.description: The profile policy table. `release` keeps the 256 MiB shipped bound; `prototype` carries its own 512 MiB local-only cap.

toolchain.description: `rustc -vV`'s release and commit-hash, the compiler that produced the bytes.

sourceTreeDigest.description: SHA-256 of the sorted repository-relative `[path, sha256]` rows of every in-repository file the units of the component's build read, as the cargo provenance observation records them.

provenanceSha256.description: RFC 6962 Merkle root over one leaf per unit of the component's build (the SHA-256 of its path-normalized, time-free input and artifact rows) and one per build-script run (its capture and resource rows). A release driver observes every unit once and derives each component's root from the leaves of its unit-graph closure.
